//: Mutation matrix for the APP LINK gate (issue #182). The gate is a BUILD assertion, not a probe: it builds the `everythingbox` target and fails in the app's own name if it does not link. So every mutant declares no build of its own (`build: null`) and is judged by native/tools/applink-gate-check.sh, which extracts the gate's own lines out of run-headless-probes.sh — this proves the gate CI runs, not a copy of it. Mutant 1 is #128 reproduced exactly; mutant 2 is the anti-vacuity check that the extraction must STOP rather than pass when the banner moves. Expect the first to take a few minutes: it is a real link of the real app.

mutants.//: THE HEADLINE MUTANT: #128's tree, byte for byte. src/core/RomPatch.cpp stays on probe_softpatch (line ~1225) but leaves the app's source list, while GameLauncher::prepareCore and RomhackInstall still call into it — so EverythingBox.exe dies on LNK2019 -> LNK1120. Before this gate the suite printed ALL HEADLESS PROBES PASSED and SOFTPATCH-OK over exactly this. Mutating CMakeLists.txt is also what makes the gate's freshness fast-path do its job: the source LIST is one of the inputs it compares against the exe, so this cannot be skipped as up to date.
mutants.name: app-source-list-drops-rompatch

mutants.//: The gate's own anti-vacuity check, the same one leafroute-mutants.json carries. Move the banner the extracting awk keys on and applink-gate-check.sh must exit 2 on its line floor rather than report a verdict — an empty extraction runs clean and would report the app as fine, which is the exact failure #182 is about.
mutants.name: gate-banner-renamed
